[[File:RecoilDampingStock-FF73.png|thumb|right|250px|The recoil-damping stock on Zam Wesell's KiSteer 1284 rifle]]
A '''recoil-damping stock''' was a modification that could be added to the butt of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster]] or [[Slugthrower rifle|projectile]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle's]] [[Stock/Legends|stock]] to lessen the recoil generated when the weapon was fired. [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle/Legends|KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle]] was equipped with a recoil-damping stock.<ref name="FF73">{{FactFile|73|WES 3-4|Zam Wesell's Weapons}}</ref>
